objective: Test whether the actual daily and weekly opening gaps of CME Bitcoin and Ether futures define fair-value arrays whose rebalancing or accepted rejection produces repeatable after-cost BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT perpetual alpha.

trader_explanation.name: CME NDOG/NWOG Delivery
sequence: CME closes at 17:00 New York and reopens at 18:00, leaving a true interval with no futures trading.
The previous CME close and new CME open define an NDOG; Friday close to Sunday open defines an NWOG.
The percentage gap is mapped onto BTCUSDT or ETHUSDT at the futures reopen so the crypto execution chart carries the same fair-value array.
If the first completed crypto bars enter the gap and reclaim CE, trade toward the prior CME close equivalent.
If price displaces away and accepts outside the gap, trade in the gap direction toward known previous-day or previous-week external liquidity.
Entry is the next completed 15-minute open; stop invalidates the gap thesis; no elapsed-time liquidation is used.

source_concept_contract.translation: Opening gaps define the state; completed lower-timeframe rebalancing or accepted rejection defines the entry.

non_overlap.session_and_silver_bullet: No Asian/London/New York range or intraday kill-zone window defines the setup; only the CME exchange halt and reopen do.
non_overlap.crt: The range is not an arbitrary prior candle; it is the actual untraded CME close-open interval.
non_overlap.fvg_unicorn_breaker_ote: No three-candle FVG, order block, breaker, OTE or liquidity-raid lifecycle is required.
non_overlap.cross_venue_exact_arrival: No microsecond lead-lag or simultaneous venue quote comparison is claimed; the gap is known at a scheduled institutional-market reopen and entry waits completed 15-minute confirmation.
non_overlap.ordinary_crypto_weekend_gap: The signal is CME's closed-market gap, not a discontinuity in 24/7 crypto trading.

stage_0_probe_contract.probe_pass: Yahoo BTC=F and ETH=F each provide >=600 finite, chronological daily rows covering all three years with open and close, and official Binance BTC/ETH 15m archives pass adjacent checksum verification.
stage_0_probe_contract.if_probe_fails: Close or replace the data source before any strategy PnL; do not infer gaps from 24/7 crypto prices alone.

conditional_data_contract.cme_source: Yahoo Finance continuous front-contract daily OHLCV, raw JSON hashed; source is a fatal-screen proxy and not rank eligible.
conditional_data_contract.execution_source: Official Binance USD-M 15-minute and funding archives with adjacent CHECKSUM verification.
conditional_data_contract.source_integrity: Record raw Yahoo JSON SHA-256, archive and checksum SHA-256, normalized hashes, row counts and timestamp diagnostics.

causal_gap_contract.ndog: For ordinary Tuesday-Friday CME trading dates, prior daily close to current daily open; mapped open time is the preceding calendar day at 18:00 New York.
causal_gap_contract.nwog: For ordinary Monday CME trading dates, prior Friday daily close to current Monday daily open; mapped open time is Sunday at 18:00 New York.
causal_gap_contract.holiday_rule: Use only consecutive ordinary Tuesday-Friday sessions or Friday-to-Monday sessions; skip any other date spacing.
causal_gap_contract.roll_exclusion: Exclude current and previous CME dates during the final five New York business days of each calendar month.
causal_gap_contract.gap_return_bps: 10000 * log(current CME open / prior CME close)
causal_gap_contract.crypto_halt_return_bps: 10000 * log(execution proxy 18:00 open / execution proxy 17:00 close)
causal_gap_contract.roll_residual_bps: gap_return_bps - crypto_halt_return_bps; candidate must satisfy a frozen absolute residual ceiling.
causal_gap_contract.mapped_prior_close: execution proxy 18:00 open / exp(CME gap return)
causal_gap_contract.availability: The gap is known only after the first CME opening print; crypto confirmation uses completed 15-minute bars from 18:00 New York onward.
causal_gap_contract.entry: Following 15-minute open after the completed confirmation bar.
causal_gap_contract.same_bar_exit: Protective stop before target; adverse observed open for stop gaps.
causal_gap_contract.unresolved: No elapsed-time forced close; unresolved positions fail the stage gate.

frozen_hypothesis_families.logic: Price enters the mapped NDOG/NWOG and closes through the frozen trigger depth toward the prior CME close equivalent.
frozen_hypothesis_families.stop: confirmation-window extreme beyond the CME open edge plus frozen ATR buffer

frozen_hypothesis_families.logic: Price holds outside the gap and produces direction-aligned displacement away from the CME open edge.
frozen_hypothesis_families.target: known prior-day or prior-week external liquidity in the gap direction
frozen_hypothesis_families.stop: mapped gap consequent encroachment plus frozen ATR buffer

frozen_candidate_grid.threshold_learning: Symbol and gap-kind minimum absolute gap thresholds are learned only from 2021 fit events.

cost_and_account_contract.fatal_screen_position: fixed unit notional for alpha screening
cost_and_account_contract.risk_and_leverage_search: only after fit, development and confirmation survival under a new exact-Bybit contract

conditional_decision.if_probe_fails: Close source stage without strategy PnL.
conditional_decision.if_zero_development_survivors: Close the exact CME NDOG/NWOG rebalance and acceptance dependency without opening 2023 confirmation or 2024.
conditional_decision.if_development_survivor_exists: Open 2023 confirmation only for fit and development survivors under the same thresholds and rules.
conditional_decision.if_confirmation_survivor_exists: Freeze exact CME source identities and exact Bybit BBO/depth, funding, execution, sizing and NAV replay before official 2024.

prohibitions: no PnL before the source probe passes
no 2023 execution archive request unless a 2022 development survivor exists
no use of daily high, low or close from the current session in the opening decision
no roll-date event in the final five business days of month
no credentials, option orders, paper, testnet or live orders
no cumulative ranking promotion from a Yahoo/Binance proxy screen
